scam_detection.definition: flagged = final risk 'high' or primary action refuse_and_end/block/report

latency_ms.unit: ms per engine step (language detection, signals, risk, decision, reply); excludes STT, TTS and network

failures.details: withheld: this split is held out and must not be used to tune the rules

limitations: The dataset is synthetic and written by the project (LLM-authored, not reviewed by native speakers); it cannot represent the diversity of real calls or adversaries who read the rules.
Transcripts are scripted text. Real speech-recognition errors differ from the synthetic noise used here.
Labels are one author's judgement; no inter-annotator agreement was measured.
Small samples: individual language profiles have 3-15 scenarios, so intervals are wide.
Latency covers the decision logic only; it excludes speech recognition, synthesis and network.
The language detector is a script and lexicon heuristic, not a trained model.
